escala_evidencia: Belgian NBB standard model (VOL) with amounts in euros shown without decimals, e.g. 'VASTE ACTIVA 21/28 74.852.045'; header '2025 EUR'
observaciones: Statutory (individual) annual accounts filed with the NBB under the full model (VOL). The income statement (Resultatenrekening, VOL-kap 4) runs across pp. 9-10. Notes 6.10 (operating results), 6.11 (financial results) and 6.12 (non-recurring income and expenses) break down the line items. A consolidated set of accounts exists (p. 38) but is not included in this document. The scale is inferred from the standard euro format, not from an explicit phrase.
